- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:929 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The fix introduces `fetch_plan_runs_page_json` and a paginated `latest_scoped_run_field` for the Plan run *capture* path, but the "other active Plan runs" check in the same `wait-plan` step still calls the OLD single-page `fetch_plan_runs_json`. The new code's own comment (lines 752–758) explicitly describes the vulnerability class this check still has — "by the time Plan labels the issue our Plan run can sit past the first 100 runs of the created=> window … run 36374918973 found it at index 96, then lost it seconds later". If a queued or in-progress Plan run for the same issue sits past index 100 of page 1, this check returns 0 active runs and the step errors out with `Plan workflow completed but issue lacks expected labels` (line 948) when it should have waited for the still-active run. The fix's stated scope is the capture path, but the same vulnerability class is now sitting in the same step and the new test file (`test_other_active_plan_runs_avoids_inline_fallback_substitution`, `test_plan_runs_payload_is_shape_validated_before_counting`) only enforces that the call stays indirect (a helper function), not that the helper paginates.
  WHY: A Plan run for the smoke issue completes without producing `ai:awaiting-approval`/`ai:implementing` (already rare), a second comment triggers another Plan run (queued/in_progress) for the same issue, and between those two events more than 100 skipped runs accumulate in the `created=>` window (the same condition #4723 documented for the capture path). The capture path now walks pages 1–10 and succeeds; the other-active check still reads page 1, sees zero active runs, and terminates the gate with `status=plan_failed` instead of waiting.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
